topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I check my phone for the third time in as many minutes; the update is the same. Flight delayed, again. The minutes stretch, each one a mile long, ticking off the chances of making it on time. I pace the airport, the echo of my steps a constant reminder of the seconds slipping away. The terminal buzzes around me, a whirl of activity, while I stand still, hostage to this ticking clock. A text goes out, brief, professional. Apologies, but it’s beyond my control. Eyes on the departure board, I wait, hoping for a miracle.
